TAHMIL AL-TAQA AL-'AAMMAH —
تema al-yawm al-fa'il lil-thawr huwa al-istiqrar al-dakhili wal-tawazun al-nafsi al-amiq. Tajid nafsaka ya sadiq al-thawr mawjudan fi bi'ah tumahid laka al-tariq li'iadat al-tarkiz ala ahdafik al-tawilah al-mada. Al-ajwa' al-falakiyah al-yawm tunsihu bi-tafadul al-hudu' ala al-sakhab, mima yumanhuka furcah thaminah li'iadat shahan taqatak al-dakhiliyah wa bina' ru'yah jadidah lil-mustaqbal. Ruhtuka al-yawm tatسم bil-sabr wal-hikmah, wa hadha ma sayajaluka malaathan liman hawlak mimman yabhatuna an al-dam wal-mushawarah.

AL-ISHQ WAL-ALAQAT —
Ida kunta murtabitan, fa-al-yawm yumthil furcah mithaliyah li-taziz al-rawabit al-atifiyah maa sharik hayatika abr hiwar hadu' wa sadiq yuzil ayyu su' fahm sabiq. Al-lahazat al-hamimah al-lati tusarun biha sa-tuid al-daf' ila al-alaqah wa tajalukuma tastamtani bi-l-waqt al-mushtarak bi-kull riqqa. Amma lil-uzzab, fa-al-falak yushir ila ihtimaliyat liqa' ghayr mutawaqqa qad yuhrik mashairka bi-tariqah ijabiyah jiddan. Kun maftuha al-qalb wal-aql, fa-al-shakhsh al-munasib qad yatulu alayka bi-wujuh basithah walakinha tha'thir amiq.

AL-ISH WAL-KARIYAR —
Ala sumat al-amal, yajibu alayka al-yawm al-tarkiz ala al-maham al-mutawaqqafah wa inqazuha bi-dhiqqa shadidah wa sabr maruf ank. Al-furas al-mutaha amamaka qad tabdu qaliwlah, walakinha tahmil fi tawayaha imkaniyat namu' kabirah lil-mustaqbal al-qurib. Ihzar al-tatarruf fil-qrarat al-sariah, wa itimad ala al-taktikat al-daliqah wal-takhthis al-istratiji al-lazim. Zamiluka fil-amal qad yuqaddimu laka musaadah ghayr muntazarah tusahimu fi hall mushkilah aliqah mundhu fatrah.

AL-MAL WAL-BARAKAH —
Al-wad al-mali yahmil laka istiqraran malhuzan yumkinuka min al-tanaffus bi-raha bad fatrah min al-tahaddiyat. Hatha huwa al-waqt al-munasib li-dirasat mashru mali jadid aw istithmar tawil al-mada yudhim laka awa'id mustaqbaliyah mutamawwijah. Tajannab al-infaf al-za'id fi shira' aghrad ghayr daruriyah, wa hifaz ala al-tوازن bayna al-tanfi' bil-mal wa tawfiruhu lil-tawari'. Al-barakah tuhitu bi-khutwatika al-maliyah mata ma ittamadta al-hikmah wal-tadbir.

AL-SIHHA WAL-TAQA —
Sahhatuka al-badaniyah wal-nafsiyah tatatallabu minka al-yawm inayah khasstah abr al-istirahat al-kafiya wal-ibtiad an masadir al-tutaq al-yawmiyah. Mumarasat bad tamarin al-yuga aw al-mashy fi tabiah sa-tusahimu kathiran fi tafriq al-taqa al-salibiyah min jismik. Ihsras ala tanawul al-wajaabat al-sihhiyah al-lati tumadduka bil-taqa al-nazifah al-lati tahtajuha li-tahammul aba' al-yawm. Naumuka al-amiq al-layla saykunu al-miftah al-asasi li-istiadat nashatik al-kamil.

AL-ITTIWAS WAL-BIAH —
Al-alaqat al-ijtimaiyah maa al-a'ila wal-asdiqa' tashhadu yawman hadian wa mili'an bil-dif' al-atifi. Laqaa' qasir maa sadiq qadim qad yuid ila zikrayat jamilah tusahimu fi tahsin mizajika bi-shakl malhuz. Ala al-mustawa al-aili, kalimat basithah min al-shukr wal-taqdir satasna fariqan kabiran fi qulub man hawlak. Istamti bi-hatha al-hudu' al-ijtimaiyi wal-tawasul al-aijabii maa al-muhitin bik.

NUSHAT AL-YAWM —
"La tastajil al-natā'ij, fa-al-ashya' al-jamilah tu'ti bi-wutriha al-khasse, wa sabruka al-yawm huwa miftah kull abwab al-khayr."

TAFASEEL AL-YAWM —
Al-raqm al-sahi: 6.
Al-lawn al-sahi: al-akhdar al-zaytuni al-hadi.
Al-burj al-mutawafiq maa: burj al-jadya.
